title: Chauffeured Historic Tour of Detroit with Flexibility
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour is totally flexible. You can decide how you want to spend the day or just relax and let the guide lead the way. It is provided by a local tour guide who has a lifetime of knowledge of Michigan and the Detroit area. Also, your guide will spend the day maximizing your Detroit area visit with a high level of client care.
